title: Multi-year submicron aerosol chemical composition at a high-altitude site in the Western Ghats of India
content:

Sonal Kumari, G. Pandithurai, Pallavi Padwal, Rohit D. Patil, V. Anil Kumar, P. P. Leena, Sachin S. Patil, Ajit Waware, Lalit R. Chaudhari
Multi-year characterization of PM1 organic aerosols at a high-altitude site in the Western Ghats reveals seasonal variability, source contributions, and atmospheric processing influenced by regional transport, biomass burning, and meteorological conditions.
